entities.summary: Al-Tamanah is a town in northwestern Syria, administratively a part of the Maarrat al-Nu'man District of the Idlib Governorate. According to the Syria Central Bureau of Statistics, al-Tamanah had a population of 7,382 in the 2004 census. Al-Tamanah is located 9 kilometers (5.6 mi) east of Khan Shaykhun and 16 kilometers (9.9 mi) northeast of Kafr Zita.
